newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Superior Metal in S$6.5 mln property sale.
newsitem.headline: Superior Metal in S$6.5 mln property sale.

text.p: Superior Metal Printing Ltd said on Wednesday it had entered into an optional agreement to sell its Gul Way property for Singapore $6.5 million to Evershine Traders Corp.
The sale was conditional on approval from relevant authorities and Superior's shareholders, Superior Metal said in a statement.

It said the property was not required for manufacturing and proceeds from the sale would be used to help finance investments in a metal container operation in China and a flexible packaging operation in Malaysia.
Among Superior's core businesses are metal pails and cans and flexible packaging.
